name: Model Context Protocol
description: The MCP Drupal module implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

suggests.drupal/node: Enables the built-in 'content' plugin (nodes as MCP resources + search-content tool).
suggests.drupal/jsonapi: Enables the built-in 'jsonapi' plugin (read content via JSON:API).
suggests.drupal/jsonapi_schema: Adds the jsonapi_schema tool to the JSON:API plugin.
suggests.drupal/ai: Enables the 'aif' plugin (AI function calls as MCP tools).
suggests.drupal/ai_agents: Enables the 'aia' plugin (AI agents as MCP tools).
suggests.drupal/tool: Enables the 'tools' plugin (Tool API tools as MCP tools).
suggests.drush/drush: Enables the 'drush' plugin (run allow-listed Drush commands as tools; dev only).
